keyword: when is the march madness selection show
claims: The 2026 Men’s March Madness Selection Show is on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 6 p.m. ET on CBS.
The 68-team field will be revealed to set the bracket for the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament.
The 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament starts with the First Four on March 17-18, 2026.
The 2026 Women’s selection show is at 8 p.m. ET on ESPN.
First Four Games are on Tuesday, March 17, 2026 and Wednesday, March 18, 2026.
First Round is on Thursday, March 19, 2026 and Friday, March 20, 2026.
The 2026 Men's Final Four will be held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Ind., on April 4 and April 6.
